src/agent_runtime/instruction_skills/author.py

Python · Tier A

Code's workspace file tools, confined to one personal skill package on the server.

Details

The Skills workbench runs the ordinary Code agent loop. Its file tools keep Code's names and argument shapes (workspace__read, workspace__patch, ...) so the model, the activity rows and the change cards behave exactly as in a Code workspace, but every path resolves inside the selected personal/<name> package and nothing else is reachable: no shell, gateway or other skill. Each save is published through the library with the request ID and before/after package revisions, so the panel can show what this specific request actually saved.
